title: Hosted API cascade insulation and rollback safepoints for customer escalations
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Summary: Several high-severity customer escalations in the past quarter revealed a repeating pattern: tenant burst -> edge/backplane retries -> downstream queueing -> KV cache eviction -> amplified 5xx/timeouts that impact non-offending tenants. This ticket implements a multi-layered mitigation: (1) escalation gates (a short-lived, per-tenant fast-fail / priority path for customers with open escalations), (2) differential retry budgets and jittered backoffs at the edge, and (3) observable rollback safepoints and rollout gates so we can rapidly revert or restrict new routing logic without taking the entire fleet offline. The goal is to stop blast-radius amplification while preserving SLOs for paid/enterprise tenants and maintain graceful degradation for lower tiers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Edge routes can apply a per-tenant escalation flag that enables a fastfail path; 2) Per-tenant retry budget exists and is enforced at proxy (configurable thresholds); 3) A rollback-safe rollout (feature flag with canary % + automated rollback on SLO regressions) is in place; 4) Dashboards show breakdown by tenant for 5xx vs internal timeouts, retry amplification metric, and current escalation flag status; 5) Runbook updated and rehearsed.
implementation_notes:
High-level design:
- Introduce 'escalation_gate' tag in tenant metadata; triggered manually by SRE/SEs during escalations.
- Edge proxy changes: add an admission controller that checks retry budget and escalation flag. If tenant is flagged, route to 'escalation-fastpath' which applies conservative fanout, strict connection limits, and fastfail on upstream queueing thresholds.
- Retry policy: implement per-tenant token bucket (budget) for retries; exhaust -> return 429 or fail-fast depending on policy. Add random jitter and incremental backoff tuned to median p95 plant latencies.
- KV cache: add aggressive compaction window when escalation_flag=true to avoid thrashing. Ensure compaction is bounded to avoid latency spikes.
- Observability: new metrics (tenant.retry_budget_used, tenant.escalation_flag, tenant.kv_eviction_rate, tenant.upstream_5xx_ratio). Add per-tenant trace sampling when escalation flag is set.
Trade-offs considered:
- Fastfail path reduces customer throughput for flagged tenants but prevents cross-tenant SLO collapse.
- Per-tenant retry budget adds CPU overhead at edge; mitigated by a lightweight token-bucket implementation in C++ module used by proxy.
- Rolling out feature-flagged routing is complex; we add automatic rollback triggers to limit human error.
decision_log: 2025-03-02: Decided to implement escalation_gate as a tenant-level flag controlled by SRE and authorized SEs; avoids automatic heuristics for initial rollout.
2025-03-04: Chose token-bucket retry budget in edge proxy (C++), not at application layer, to minimize added latency.
2025-03-06: Opted for conservative KV compaction behavior rather than full disablement to protect cold-start latency.
2025-03-10: Added automated rollback on >2% increase in global p95 latency during canary.
